$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # outcomes
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    script/bad-code: Codes gives a code with a space in it.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        The project's Codes gave echo's error a code an outcome can't hold: the code "a b" can't be held in an outcome: a code is not empty, and holds no space, semicolon, carriage return or newline.
        Fix Codes. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/cl-bad: The classifier gives a detail with a space at its start.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        echo's classifier steered gave a detail an outcome can't hold: " padded" can't be held in an outcome: it is one line, not empty, with no space at either end.
        Fix the classifier. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/cl-error: The classifier fails.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        echo's classifier steered failed: no detail today
        Fix the classifier. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/cl-panic: The classifier panics.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        echo's classifier steered panicked: classifier boom
        Fix the classifier. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/codes-panic: Codes panics on echo's error.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        The project's Codes panicked on echo's error: codes boom
        Fix Codes. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/reason: echo's probe says no with a reason of two lines.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        echo's probe said the case isn't for it, with a reason an outcome can't hold: "two\nlines" can't be held in an outcome: it is one line, not empty, with no space at either end.
        Fix the probe. An update writes nothing for this cell.
